investigation.root_cause: UNRESOLVED. The failure log has no raw inspect snapshot or predicate code. No tmpfs/image-volume/label hypothesis is treated as proven.

source_hypothesis.description: The native client image extends official postgres18.6. Database overrides the inherited data-volume destination; active worker-provision/worker-grant clients declare only the secrets mount, so image VOLUME inheritance may create an extra anonymous /var/lib/postgresql volume. Inactive operator clients share that image. This is a source-derived hypothesis, not the proven runtime predicate.
